Anomalous activity analysis station

This is a measurement device, widely used by ecologists in The Zone. It is rather heavy, but is staple for scientific analysis of anomalies - it can draw heatmaps of anomalous activity in anomaly fields, capture anomaly density and take various other measurements. Unfortunately, this is not of much use to any stalker in The Zone, however, Mobile Science Labs would gladly pay for recovery of these devices.

SI-65A Oscillograph

The SI-65A Oscillograph is an oscilloscope used in mobile science labs around The Zone. It is used for conducting various measurements and tests, specifically with electronic devices and certain anomalous phenomena. It operates by detecting electrical and gravitational oscillations caused by anomalous activity. Unfortunately, this is not of much use to any stalker in The Zone, however, Mobile Science Labs would gladly pay for recovery of these devices.

Old microwave transformer taken out of an old Soviet microwave oven. A transformer is generally a passive electrical device that transfers energy from one electrical circuit to another one via a magnetic field, without a conductive connection between the two thick copper wires. This one was generally used for cooking or warming up food within minutes or seconds. Traders would gladly pay good money for this due to the parts potential.
